description: The plot illustrates the similarity of Hidden State Alignments (HSAs) across different languages. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 22, with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled “Similarity” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 0.45, with tick labels at 0.05 intervals. There are three lines displayed on the plot. The first line is blue, solid, and begins at approximately 0.38 at x=0, decreasing to approximately 0.18 at x=22. The second line is orange, solid, and begins at approximately 0.35 at x=0, decreasing to approximately 0.15 at x=22. The third line is green, solid, and begins at approximately 0.32 at x=0, decreasing to approximately 0.12 at x=22.
